sources.quotation: Flip Effects, other Trigger Effects that activate when a monster is flipped face-up, and many effects that activate “after damage calculation” activate here and form a Chain if necessary.
If "Man-Eater Bug" is the only monster on the field when it is flipped, it destroys itself.
If you need to select a monster for the Flip effect to target, you cannot target a monster that has already been destroyed during damage calculation.
